name: Hina ~Ippai Daisuki~
source:
Main character lives alone while attending part-time work. One day father brings a clone girl to protagonist's home saying that girl is needed for secret laboratory research and should hide at some safe place for a while. Girl does not know anything about life - what are the first things to teach her? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
